finalCta.h4: 5FY - 1.6L Turbo Petrol (EP6DTS) - The GTi / RC Engine
finalCta.paragraph: History: The turbocharged Prince variant - developed jointly with BMW and also used in the Mini Cooper S - powered the 207 GTi and RC models, delivering 175hp through direct injection and a twin-scroll turbocharger. However, the THP engine suffers from several well-documented design flaws: an undersized hydraulic timing chain tensioner, faulty piston rings causing excessive oil consumption, and an inadequate turbo lubrication system. These defects particularly affect engines produced before April 2010.
